finding: The documented five-character Japanese species-name truncation recovery also expanded intentionally longer 6..9-character nicknames matching the species prefix.
fix: Restrict species-prefix recovery to exactly five nickname characters.
coverage: Species-name and nickname lengths 0..10, exact prefixes and mismatch at every nickname character; copied bytes, terminator and output guards checked.
limitations: Controlled species/name arrays and mocked GetMonData/StringCopy. Invalid species IDs, selected party indices, malformed mon data, actual Japanese font behavior and game runtime remain unverified. A five-character custom nickname equal to a species prefix remains inherently indistinguishable from vanilla truncation.
